verdict.rationale: Supabase gives indirect levers rather than first-class retention controls. Self-hosting is positioned for 'full control over your data'. Supabase Cron can run scheduled SQL, so users can build their own deletion jobs. Backup retention windows are fixed by plan (7/14/up to 30 days), with PITR as an add-on, and CLI telemetry can be opted out. Missing for 10: documented configurable retention policies for data, backups and logs; documented project/account data deletion or purge guarantees; any GDPR-style deletion workflow; independent corroboration.
